text.insert: Start with doctor for installed-file differences, discovery for workspace coverage, and a small real edit for end-to-end acceptance. These checks answer different questions.

1. Open a new client session in the target project. Ask it to explain one existing documentation page without editing. Expect docs_discover and a tree, search, or read call against the correct project ID.
2. Ask for one source-supported documentation correction without naming the tools. Expect
for the current document hash and a typed edit with
. Other topics and component references are optional.
when the task finishes. Read back the page and inspect it in the shared UI. A successful tool response alone does not establish that the prose is correct.

4. For a Canvas or Sequence edit, expect docs_component_read and an advertised typed component action using the document and sidecar revision hashes. For a multi-project request, verify each project separately and report partial success explicitly.

5. Repeat the implicit request in each supported coding client. Separately exercise a built-in agent through its existing staged review flow after shared guidance changes. Protocol tests, installer checks, and external edits do not prove model behavior in every client.

bun packages/docs-mcp/src/cli.ts tools
bun packages/docs-mcp/src/cli.ts doctor
bun packages/docs-mcp/src/cli.ts discover --workspace ..

Use advertised schemas for exact arguments. Common edits include docs_write_text, docs_insert, and docs_apply_ops. Component action names are generated from the registered actions. Do not infer a name or bypass an unsupported action with a filesystem write.

text.insert:
bun packages/docs-mcp/src/cli.ts restore /tmp/codecaine-docs-install.json
bun packages/docs-mcp/src/cli.ts restore /tmp/codecaine-docs-install.json --write

Preview restore first. Restore verifies backup and installed-file hashes and refuses to overwrite post-install changes. Claude can update its configuration during normal use, so an exact restore may refuse. To remove only its MCP entry, use claude mcp remove codecaine-docs -s user and preserve the newer file. Skill copies and pi configuration require their own reviewed cleanup.

Runtime state defaults to ~/.local/state/codecaine-docs or CODECAINE_DOCS_STATE_DIR. daemon.json contains the bearer credential and service address. daemon.lock and startup.lock coordinate startup, and service.log records daemon output. Do not share daemon.json as a diagnostic artifact. No model API key is needed for this editing service.
Task contexts and guarded undo are process-local. A task context holds the pinned guidance snapshot, whether the task has read the
topic, and one edit baseline per page.
releases that context and does not revert applied edits. Stopping the service loses that in-memory state, while saved documents remain on disk. Cross-project edits are not atomic.

Save tool results, final hashes, lint findings, and a reviewed content diff when recording acceptance. Label a user-reported successful exercise separately from automated evidence. Keep those dated records in objectives/docs-mcp-integration/artifacts and the handoff, outside the maintained corpus.
Page Creation, Move, Rename, and Deletion

Page and section operations include descendants. docs_move and docs_rename preview their complete file and reference changes. Apply them with preview:false and expected_tree_hash. Use docs_set_title for display titles.

Management operations keep recovery journals and expose docs_management_restore. Restore refuses subsequent edits or added descendants. Shared-store operations serialize during a reorganization, while independent service processes remain separate authorities.

To delete, first call docs_delete with path and expected_hash. Its default preview returns the files to remove and tree_hash. Review those files and the user's deletion authorization. Apply with preview:false and expected_tree_hash set to that preview hash. Changes to corpus files invalidate the preview. No user documentation is deleted merely by requesting the preview.
Deletion refuses external references into the deleted subtree. Move shared assets with
before removing their owner page. Section moves rewrite both descendant links and shared or external asset paths. Use
to request deletion of a section and all descendants.

After a move or rename, read the destination, inspect rewritten links, and run docs_check on affected pages. After deletion, inspect docs_tree and check remaining affected pages. Reconnect clients after the service restart so their tool catalogs include docs_move, docs_rename, and docs_delete. When the daemon address changes, restart shared workbenches.
gives the complete section, asset, and recovery procedure.
